title: The Tricky Problem of Disarming and Integrating Pro-Iran Militias in Iraq
gist: A Warcast episode note flags a hard Sept. 30 deadline: the U.S.-led anti-ISIS coalition withdraws from Iraq the same day Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi promised Trump his government would disarm and integrate Iran-aligned militias, a promise the episode frames as difficult to keep given Iran's entrenched interests in Iraq.

insights.claim: Forces of the U.S.-led coalition against the Islamic State are expected to fully withdraw from Iraq by Sept. 30, 2026.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: A firm date for a U.S. troop presence change in Iraq, relevant to regional security-risk and defense-posture tracking through Q3 2026.

insights.claim: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi promised U.S. President Donald Trump that his government would disarm and integrate pro-Iran militias into Iraq's security forces by the same Sept. 30 deadline as the coalition withdrawal.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: A concrete, dated political commitment whose failure or fulfillment will signal Iraq's trajectory toward or away from Iranian-aligned armed factions operating outside state control.

insights.claim: The episode's framing ('The Tricky Problem') and its focus on Iran's interests in Iraq, the militias' relationship to the Iraqi government, and the challenges Baghdad faces integrating them signal that the disarmament-and-integration promise is viewed as unlikely to be cleanly achieved by the deadline.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Investors and analysts tracking Iraq stability/energy-sector risk should not assume the Sept. 30 militia-integration commitment will be met on schedule or in full.
